## Claim or argument affected

Link the file, issue, or pull request and identify the precise assertion or step.

## Example or gap

Specify all relevant data and assumptions. Give a reproducible calculation or a detailed
explanation of why the step does not follow.

## Consequences and possible repair

State which conclusion is affected, distinguish a confirmed counterexample from a suspected gap,
and suggest a repair or additional hypothesis if known. Cite relevant sources.
